top.name: Bluetooth/GPS pet tracker collar
top.signals: TikTok #PetTracker tag has 90M+ views; 'dog GPS collar' shows ~$2.50 avg CPC, signaling high buyer intent · GPS tracker smart-dog-collar market forecast to grow from $0.72B (2026) to $1.64B by 2035, 9.4% CAGR
top.risk: Cellular models need EU carrier/network compatibility and ongoing data plans — confusion here kills conversion.
top.angle: Sell peace-of-mind: short-form video of live location alerts and geofence 'escape' footage.

rows.name: Short/minimalist press-on nail kits
rows.angle: Lead with 'wear it tonight' comfort and short/minimalist EU-friendly shapes instead of competing on flashy 3D designs.

rows.name: Flat-back stud/hoop earring sets
rows.angle: Lead with the 'sleep comfortably in your earrings' hook; sell as matched sets for gifting.

rows.name: Battery-powered heated throw blanket
rows.angle: Frame explicitly as an energy-bill saver ('heat yourself, not the room') for EU winter — the exact motive driving real demand.

rows.name: Portable garment steamer
rows.angle: Position as a travel/small-apartment essential — no iron or board, wrinkle-free in 60 seconds — and demo on camera.

rows.name: Pull-up bar + resistance band home workout set
rows.angle: Bundle bar + bands + a simple home-program PDF so it reads as a system, not a commodity part.

rows.name: Sauna blanket (at-home wellness)
rows.angle: Sell as an at-home spa/detox ritual with before/after sweat content, priced as a self-care gift.

rows.name: Portable espresso maker
rows.angle: Target EU camping/hiking and van-life audiences with outdoor-brew demo content ahead of the autumn trip season.

rows.name: 4K AI mini security camera
rows.angle: Only viable with clear GDPR-compliant data-storage messaging (EU servers) as the differentiator vs generic listings.

rows.name: Smart LED strip lights (music-sync)
rows.angle: Only worth listing as an add-on/upsell to another order — don't build a standalone campaign around it.
